# Configuration reference

Generated from the doc comments of `alkahest-core` and from `alkahest config show`.
See [Configuration](../guide/configuration.md) for how the layers combine.

## Keys

Sections are TOML tables: `server.port` is `port` under `[server]`. A key shown as
`unset` has no fixed default (it is derived, for example from the data directory).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server.host` | String | `127.0.0.1` | Host or IP to bind. Anything but loopback requires API keys (`ALK-SP-0006`). |
| `server.port` | u16 | `11435` | TCP port. |
| `server.max_body_bytes` | u64 | `67108864` | Largest accepted request body in bytes. Generous by default because Ollama and OpenAI requests may carry base64 images; it still stops a client from exhausting memory. |
| `server.request_timeout_secs` | u64 | `0` | Whole-request timeout in seconds; `0` disables it. Off by default because a streamed generation legitimately runs for minutes. |
| `server.shutdown_timeout_secs` | u64 | `30` | Seconds in-flight requests may keep running after a stop signal before the server stops waiting for them and tears engines down (ALK-SP-0009.R4). |
| `server.cors_origins` | list of String | `[]` | Browser origins allowed by CORS (`https://app.example`, or `*` for any). Empty, the default, sends no CORS headers at all, so browsers block cross-origin calls. |
| `server.endpoints.ollama` | bool | `true` | Ollama native API, `/api/*`. |
| `server.endpoints.openai` | bool | `true` | OpenAI-compatible API, `/v1/*` except the Anthropic and decision routes. |
| `server.endpoints.anthropic` | bool | `true` | Anthropic Messages API, `/v1/messages`. |
| `server.endpoints.decisions` | bool | `true` | Decision API, `/v1/systemone` and `/v1/decisions`. |
| `server.tls.enabled` | bool | `false` | Serve HTTPS instead of plain HTTP. |
| `server.tls.cert` | optional PathBuf | unset | Certificate chain (PEM, leaf first). Default `<data_dir>/tls/cert.pem`. |
| `server.tls.key` | optional PathBuf | unset | Private key (PEM: PKCS#8, PKCS#1 or SEC1). Default `<data_dir>/tls/key.pem`. |
| `server.tls.reload_interval_secs` | u64 | `60` | Seconds between checks of the files for changes; `0` reloads on SIGHUP only. |
| `store.models_dir` | optional PathBuf | unset | Root of Alkahest's own content-addressed store. Default: `<data_dir>/models`. |
| `store.ollama.enabled` | bool | `true` | Whether to look for and expose Ollama models. |
| `store.ollama.path` | optional PathBuf | unset | Explicit store path. Default: `OLLAMA_MODELS`, `~/.ollama/models`, then the Linux service directory, whichever exists first. Alkahest never writes there. |
| `scheduler.keep_alive` | KeepAlive | `5m` | Idle time before a model is unloaded (Ollama semantics, see `KeepAlive`). |
| `scheduler.max_loaded` | u32 | `0` | Maximum models loaded at once; `0` lets the scheduler decide from memory. |
| `scheduler.num_parallel` | u32 | `0` | Parallel requests per loaded model; `0` lets the scheduler decide. |
| `scheduler.max_queue` | u32 | `512` | Requests allowed to wait for a model before new ones get HTTP 503. |
| `engines.dir` | optional PathBuf | unset | Where recipes install engines. Default: `<data_dir>/engines`. |
| `engines.overrides.<id>.path` | optional PathBuf | unset | Use this executable instead of the one the recipe installed. |
| `engines.overrides.<id>.extra_args` | list of String | unset | Extra command-line arguments appended when the engine is started. |
| `engines.auto_install` | bool | `false` | Download and install a missing engine the first time a model needs it, instead of failing with `alkahest engines install <id>`. Off by default: it fetches executables. |
| `auth.require_key_for_remote` | bool | `true` | Require an API key for requests that do not come from loopback (`ALK-SP-0006`). Turning it off on a non-loopback bind also needs `serve --allow-unauthenticated`. |
| `auth.require_on_loopback` | bool | `false` | Require an API key from loopback clients too (ALK-SP-0006.R1), for hosts where other local users or a local reverse proxy must not get free access. |
| `auth.trusted_proxies` | list of IpAddr | `[]` | Reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` is believed. Empty by default: the client is the socket peer, and forwarding headers from anyone else are never trusted. |
| `auth.key_store` | optional PathBuf | unset | Key store file. Default: `<data_dir>/keys.db`. |
| `auth.audit_log` | bool | `true` | Append one JSON line per key-authenticated or refused request to `<log_dir>/audit.jsonl` (ALK-SP-0006.R5). Never contains keys or bodies. |
| `hf.endpoint` | String | `https://huggingface.co` | Hub endpoint, overridable for mirrors. |
| `logging.level` | String | `info` | Level or `tracing` filter directive (`info`, `debug`, `alkahest_sched=trace,info`). |
| `logging.format` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | Line format. |
| `logging.file` | bool | `true` | Also write to a rotating file in the log directory. |
| `logging.dir` | optional PathBuf | unset | Log directory. Default: the platform log dir. |
| `logging.rotation` | one of `daily`, `hourly`, `never` | `daily` | File rotation period. |
| `logging.max_files` | usize | `7` | Rotated files kept before the oldest is deleted. |
| `pull.max_bytes_per_sec` | optional u64 | unset | Bandwidth cap of one `pull` in bytes per second, shared by all its connections. Absent or `0` means unlimited. Overridden by `ALKAHEST_PULL_MAX_BPS`. |
| `catalogs[].name` | String | unset | Unique catalog name (lower-case letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`); names the snapshot directory `<data_dir>/catalogs/<name>/`. |
| `catalogs[].url` | String | unset | Git repository URL (`https://`), or `file://` path of a plain catalog directory for air-gapped installs. |
| `catalogs[].ref` | String | unset | Branch or tag to follow. |
| `catalogs[].subdir` | String | unset | Folder of the catalog inside the repository (`.` for the repository root). |
| `catalogs[].pin` | optional String | unset | Commit id the catalog is frozen at; a pinned catalog is never refreshed. |
| `catalogs[].enabled` | bool | unset | Whether the catalog contributes entries. |
| `catalogs[].refresh_interval` | String | unset | How old a snapshot may get before a background refresh (`30m`, `24h`, `7d`). |
| `catalogs[].raw_url` | optional String | unset | Raw file URL template for hosts other than GitHub, GitLab and Gitea/Forgejo, with `{commit}` and `{path}` placeholders. |
| `catalogs[].archive_url` | optional String | unset | Commit archive (`tar.gz`) URL template for other hosts, with a `{commit}` placeholder. |
| `catalog_limits.max_snapshot_bytes` | u64 | `16777216` | Largest catalog snapshot in bytes (all its files together); at most 1 GiB. |
| `catalog_limits.max_file_bytes` | u64 | `1048576` | Largest single catalog file in bytes; at most 256 MiB. |
| `catalog_limits.max_archive_bytes` | u64 | `268435456` | Largest commit archive (`tar.gz`, the fallback transport) in bytes, at most 4 GiB; its decompressed stream is bounded to four times this. |

## Environment variables that set a key

These win over every file.

| Variable | Sets |
|---|---|
| `ALKAHEST_HOST` | `server.host` and `server.port` (`host`, `host:port`, `:port` or a URL) |
| `ALKAHEST_MODELS` | `store.models_dir` |
| `ALKAHEST_OLLAMA_MODELS` | `store.ollama.path` |
| `ALKAHEST_OLLAMA_ENABLED` | `store.ollama.enabled` |
| `ALKAHEST_KEEP_ALIVE` | `scheduler.keep_alive` |
| `ALKAHEST_MAX_LOADED_MODELS` | `scheduler.max_loaded` |
| `ALKAHEST_NUM_PARALLEL` | `scheduler.num_parallel` |
| `ALKAHEST_MAX_QUEUE` | `scheduler.max_queue` |
| `ALKAHEST_ENGINES_DIR` | `engines.dir` |
| `ALKAHEST_HF_ENDPOINT` | `hf.endpoint` |
| `ALKAHEST_PULL_MAX_BPS` | `pull.max_bytes_per_sec` |
| `ALKAHEST_LOG` | `logging.level` |
| `ALKAHEST_LOG_FORMAT` | `logging.format` |
| `ALKAHEST_LOG_DIR` | `logging.dir` |
